records.title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
records.reason: OPRD is an on-policy representation-distillation training method; the paper does not establish lower LLM inference cost.

records.title: Ego-R1: Agentic Chain-of-Tool-Thought for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning
records.reason: Ego-R1 improves egocentric video reasoning with tool use; it does not present a concrete serving/inference optimization.

records.title: Combee: Scaling Prompt Learning for Self-Improving Language Model Agents
records.reason: Combee reduces wall-clock time for self-improving agent prompt learning through parallelization, but the measured 17x improvement is for offline prompt-learning/reflection on reused traces, not online LLM inference. Its link to KV/cache serving is weak.

records.title: DUEL: Exact Likelihood for Masked Diffusion via Deterministic Unmasking
records.reason: DUEL computes exact likelihood for deterministic masked-diffusion sampling policies to support evaluation; it does not propose faster sampling or lower inference cost despite broad inference-system lineage.

records.title: ASMIL: Attention-Stabilized Multiple Instance Learning for Whole Slide Imaging
records.reason: ASMIL addresses whole-slide-image classification, not LLM inference.
